summary: Practise stakeholder registers, RACI charts, issue logs, and action plans. Explore this five-day foundation course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Stakeholder management helps project, service, and change professionals coordinate expectations, responsibilities, and decisions across teams. The training covers building stakeholder registers, assessing influence and engagement gaps, and assigning ownership with RACI charts. You’ll also practise recording commitments, managing escalations, and reporting unresolved concerns through issue and decision logs, communication records, and action plans.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who coordinate stakeholder responsibilities and follow-through across projects, services, and change initiatives.
prerequisites: Experience working with project, service, or change-related stakeholders is useful. No coding or specialist software knowledge is required.
